check(document.querySelector('#collage-status').classList.contains('err'), '250 cm is rejected') && check(document.querySelector('#collage-status').textContent.includes('200'), 'size error mentions the 200 cm limit')

(async () => { const small = { fmt: ellashop.FORMATS.find(f => f.id === '10x15'), orient: 'portrait' }; check(ellashop.collageDpi(ellashop.collageSheet()) === 150, '30x40 uses 150 DPI') && check(ellashop.collageDpi(small) === 300, '10x15 uses 300 DPI'); const canvas = await ellashop.renderCollage(ellashop.collageSheet()); return check(canvas.width === 1772 && canvas.height === 2362, '30x40 render is 1772x2362: ' + canvas.width + 'x' + canvas.height); })()

(() => { const gap = document.querySelector('#collage-gap'); gap.value = '0'; gap.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); gap.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); const cut = document.querySelector('#collage-cutlines'); if (!cut.checked) cut.click(); return check(ellashop.collageSheet().gap === 0 && ellashop.collageSheet().cutLines, 'gap 0 with cut lines before moving'); })()

(async () => { const sheet = ellashop.collageSheet(), dpi = ellashop.collageDpi(sheet); check(sheet.cutLines && Number(sheet.gap) === 0, 'sheet would print cut lines'); const line = ellashop.collageSharedSegments(ellashop.cellRects(sheet))[0]; check(!!line, 'sheet has a cut line'); const withCut = await ellashop.renderCollage(sheet), noCut = await ellashop.renderCollage(sheet, { cutLines: false }); const img = ellashop.canvasPrints.item.img, moved = document.createElement('canvas'); moved.width = img.naturalWidth; moved.height = img.naturalHeight; moved.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const px = (c, x, y) => [...c.getContext('2d').getImageData(x, y, 1, 1).data].slice(0, 3); const diff = (a, b) => a.reduce((s, v, k) => s + Math.abs(v - b[k]), 0); let hit = null; for (let t = .1; t < .9 && !hit; t += .05) { const x = line.dir === 'row' ? ellashop.mm2px(line.x, dpi) - 1 : ellashop.mm2px(line.x + line.w * t, dpi), y = line.dir === 'row' ? ellashop.mm2px(line.y + line.h * t, dpi) : ellashop.mm2px(line.y, dpi) - 1; if (diff(px(withCut, x, y), px(noCut, x, y)) > 150) hit = [x, y]; } check(!!hit, 'found a spot where the cut line shows'); const [x, y] = hit, m = px(moved, x, y); return check(diff(m, px(noCut, x, y)) < diff(m, px(withCut, x, y)), 'no cut line on the canvas front: moved ' + m + ' at ' + hit); })()

(() => { const item = ellashop.canvasPrints.item, sizeButton = document.querySelector('#canvas-formats button[data-id="30x40"]'); return check(document.querySelector('#canvas-view').classList.contains('active'), 'transfer switches to Canvas') && check(ellashop.canvasPrints.items.length === 1 && item?.fmt.id === '30x40', 'one 30x40 Canvas item is created') && check(ellashop.canvasPrints.sel === item, 'new Canvas item is selected') && check(item.img.naturalWidth === 1772 && item.img.naturalHeight === 2362, 'Canvas item image is 1772x2362') && check(sizeButton.classList.contains('on'), '30x40 Canvas size button is selected') && check(document.querySelector('#collage-status').textContent === 'Moved to Canvas', 'Collage reports the move'); })()
